title: Suzu Travels — India e-Visa made simple
_status: spec only 2026-10-08 (scheduled run blocked at setup-motion.sh) — needs photos + proposed/mg-window.patch, then lint/snapshot/render
_music_note: Last two rendered reels used Our Story Begins (kerala) and Vadodora (dmc); queued unesco-45 uses Magistar. Tabuk = light, upbeat, last used 30 Sep. Fallback: Naraina.

_sources.types: indianvisaonline.gov.in/evisa/tvoa.html (fetched 2026-10-08): e-Tourist Visa 30 days (valid from first arrival), 1 year and 5 years (multiple entries, from ETA grant).
_sources.window: Same page/FAQ: apply at least 4 days before arrival; up to 120 days before travel (30-day, 1-year, 5-year). Also passportindex.org 'India extends e-Tourist Visa planning window to four months'.
_sources.steps: Same page: apply online, upload photo + passport page, ETA issued by email, biometrics mandatorily captured at immigration on arrival; passport valid 6+ months with 2 blank pages; fee non-refundable (no price shown on screen).
_sources.dropped: Port counts (page lists 33/19 in FAQ vs 36/38 in checkpost list — inconsistent) and stay-per-visit rules (differ by nationality) — NOT on screen.
_sources.tip: 'Apply 3–4 weeks ahead' and 'use only the official site' are Suzu tips, not statistics.
